author: HuntyTheFirst
quote: I have no idea how this game received 99 score from Critics, the gameplay is straight up boring and extremely restrictive. As well as a lot of hate toward some specific points, this is not GTA. The visuals aren't anything "revolutionary" as many claim, the graphics are there sure but not revolutionary by any means. This game is probably worth 40 euro on a good day, 100 is not justified at all
